Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class UserResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.UserResource
@Path("/users") @RequestScoped @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class UserResource extends Object
REST endpoint for user-related operations.

This class manages requests pertaining to user entities, including profile retrieval, user updates, manager assignments, and compact listings. It applies role-based access control and delegates processing to the service layer with appropriate validation.
